letter.subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Water, Brisbane
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in your Brisbane Water team for the 2027 intake, advertised on SEEK. Working across water resources, flooding and stormwater with experienced specialists is the direction I want my civil career to take.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and then field engineer at Grand Travaux, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day and preparing site reports, material records and progress reports.

Flood and water balance modelling are not part of my experience yet, so I would be learning those tools in the program. I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa and am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane.
I would welcome the chance to talk about joining your graduate program. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
